result.topic_en: A derivation of Lagrange's inversion theorem: given x = t + u f(x), expand φ(x) as a power series in u with coefficients given by derivatives with respect to t.
result.transcription:
Math. 22
Lagranges Lehrsatz [-466/-] 17
(17)

Gegeben: $x = t + ufx$
Gesucht $\varphi x$.

Die Grundgleichung gibt allgemein
$\frac{d\psi x}{du} = fx.\frac{d\psi x}{dt}$.

Man setze
$\varphi x = \int \varphi' x.dx$
$\varphi_{,} x = \int fx.\varphi' x.dx$
$\varphi_{,,} x = \int fx^2.\varphi' x.dx$
$\varphi_{,,,} x = \int fx^3.\varphi' x.dx$
u.s.w

Also
$\frac{d\varphi x}{du} = \frac{d\varphi_{,} x}{dt}$
$\frac{d\varphi_{,} x}{du} = \frac{d\varphi_{,,} x}{dt}$
$\frac{d\varphi_{,,} x}{du} = \frac{d\varphi_{,,,} x}{dt}$
u.s.w

$\frac{d\varphi x}{du} = \frac{d\varphi_{,} x}{dt}$
$\frac{d^2\varphi x}{du^2} = \frac{d^2\varphi_{,,} x}{dt^2}$
$\frac{d^3\varphi x}{du^3} = \frac{d^3\varphi_{,,,} x}{dt^3}$
u.s.w

Setzt man
$\varphi x = \varphi t + uFt + \frac{1}{2}uuF_{,}t + \frac{1}{6}u^3F_{,,}t + \text{u.s.w.} + \frac{u^n}{1.2.3\ldots n}F_{(n-1)}t + \text{u.s.w.}$
so ist
$\frac{\partial^n\varphi x}{du^n} = F_{(n-1)}t + uF_{(n)}t + \frac{1}{2}uuF_{(n+1)}t + \text{u.s.w.}$
$= \frac{\partial^n\varphi_n x}{dt^n}$. [-...-] $= \frac{\partial^n[\varphi_n t + uGt + \frac{1}{2}uuG_{,}t + ..]}{\partial t^n}$
Also $F_{(n-1)}t = \frac{\partial^n\varphi_n t}{\partial t^n} = \frac{\partial^{n-1} ft^n.\varphi' t}{\partial t^{n-1}}$ W.Z.B.W

$\varphi x = \varphi t + uft.\varphi' t + \frac{1}{2}uu.\frac{\partial ft^2.\varphi' t}{\partial t} + \frac{1}{6}u^3\frac{\partial\partial ft^3.\varphi' t}{\partial t^2}$

methods.what: Basic PDE satisfied by any function of x defined implicitly by x = t + u f(x)
Auxiliary functions φ_n(x) = ∫ f(x)^n φ'(x) dx
Relation between u-derivatives and t-derivatives: d^nφ/du^n = d^nφ_n/dt^n
Lagrange inversion: coefficient of u^n/n! is d^{n-1}/dt^{n-1}[f(t)^n φ'(t)], obtained by setting u=0
methods.quote: Also $F_{(n-1)}t = \frac{\partial^n\varphi_n t}{\partial t^n} = \frac{\partial^{n-1} ft^n.\varphi' t}{\partial t^{n-1}}$ W.Z.B.W
$\varphi x = \varphi t + uft.\varphi' t + \frac{1}{2}uu.\frac{\partial ft^2.\varphi' t}{\partial t} + \frac{1}{6}u^3\frac{\partial\partial ft^3.\varphi' t}{\partial t^2}$
